title: Voiceover Chunk
description: The shape returned by claim_next_pending_voiceover_chunk() / get_completed_voiceover_chunks_in_order() — one paid (or reused) TTS generation unit. See docs/architecture/voiceover-pipeline.md#chunking-strategy and #chunk-identity.

chunk_index.description: 0-based position in overall assembly order — never derived from filename.

section_id.description: The script section this chunk's text came from — stable across script sections, per Step 7.
